name: durga-library-system
description: Durga Digital Library Management System - Production Monorepo

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=client
scripts.clean: rimraf client/dist server/dist node_modules/*/node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules
